evidence.decision: Names action before metaphor, selects standard mapping versus custom tintable vector, optically balances shape and separates glyphs from document/launcher identity.
evidence.artifact: Delivers corrected glyph assignments, scalable asset specifications or implementation with meaningful custom descriptions.
evidence.transformation: Task toolbar replaces heart-for-Save and decorative Delete illustration with standard coherent command metaphors while preserving personality in content.
evidence.verification: Checks actual displayed size beside text, appearance/direction and selection; fails lost metaphor or tint-erased meaning without inventing native accessibility results.
evidence.applicability: Preserves localized characters/direction, authorized Apple-product symbols and Mac document fold/small-size specifications distinct from app-icon canvases.
evidence.handoffs: Hands symbol configuration to SF Symbols and product identity to App icons.
evidence.distinctiveness: Action mapping, tintable silhouette and optical versus geometric centering determine the glyph changes.
